desc: The Muddy Pathfinder Gun Case line protects long guns in the field, at the range or in transit. Cases are built from rugged, abrasion- and water-resistant 600 denier fabric with a padded interior to cushion the firearm, and an exterior pocket keeps ammo and gear close at hand. The line includes a 52" shotgun case and a 48" rifle case, each offered in Mossy Oak Bottomland camo or Peat Moss.
